authority: CEO Round 156: 'Rebuild C2-Y against the strongest plausible incumbent baseline. Compare VIEshunt-like controller vs C2-Y predictor using: same patient population, same physiological perturbations, same measurement availability, same computational budget where relevant, same false-alarm constraint. Primary endpoint: lead time at a predefined false-alert rate.'
constitutional_basis: Article IV — no fallback epistemology (cannot use weaker baseline)
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate (baseline parameters frozen BEFORE C2-Y runs)
Article XXVII — no threshold invention (lead time + FA thresholds have provenance from EMPIRICAL_THRESHOLD_PROVENANCE_V1.json)
Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion ('beat VIEshunt-like' is NOT 'beat VIEshunt')
Article XXIX — separate implementation from mechanism (baseline reproduction failure is implementation failure, not incumbent weakness)
Article XXXII — state strongest alternative explanation (incumbent may have internal R&D we cannot see)

the_strongest_plausible_incumbent.name: Unified Intelligent Shunt Baseline (UISB) v1.0
the_strongest_plausible_incumbent.description: The strongest combination of publicly demonstrated capabilities from VIEshunt + Nature 2026 ICP monitor + Codman threshold alerting. NOT a real product — a best-plausible hypothetical incumbent that a well-resourced company could plausibly assemble from public knowledge.

components.name: VIEshunt-style adaptive controller
components.function: Posture-dependent ICP reference trajectory + PI control on ICP error
components.demonstrated_in_source: Acute ovine study: posture detection → reference adjustment → ICP regulation + CSF bolus perturbation response
components.implementation: Standard PI controller with posture-dependent reference. Gains pre-registered from VIEshunt-published ICP error response.

components.name: Nature-2026-style chronic ICP sensor
components.function: Continuous long-term ICP measurement with home monitoring capability
components.demonstrated_in_source: 20-patient first-in-human safety study; stable readings over follow-up; some shunt failure detection
components.implementation: Pressure sensor model with realistic drift + noise (parameters from published figures where available, MODEL_DERIVED ranges where not)

components.name: Codman-style threshold alarm
components.function: Fixed-threshold alerting when ICP crosses clinical boundary (15/20/25 mmHg)
components.source: FDA 510(k) database + marketed products (Codman ICP Express, Medtronic Codman, Integra Neuroscience)
components.implementation: Standard threshold-based alert at clinically standard 15/20/25 mmHg levels

what_UISB_does_NOT_have: Latent degradation prediction (no public system demonstrates this)
Response-manifold deviation analysis (no public system demonstrates this)
Failure-mode classification from response dynamics (no public system demonstrates this)
Longitudinal patient-specific baseline tracking (no public system demonstrates this)
the_strongest_plausible_incumbent.epistemic_status_of_UISB: HYPOTHETICAL — no one has publicly integrated VIEshunt + Nature ICP monitor + Codman threshold alerting. This is the strongest plausible incumbent, NOT a real product. The real incumbent may have internal R&D we cannot see (Article XXXII).
the_strongest_plausible_incumbent.alternative_explanation_to_state_explici: An incumbent (e.g., Medtronic, Integra, or a VIEshunt commercializer) may have internal chronic + prediction R&D that is not publicly disclosed. Our UISB baseline may UNDERESTIMATE the true incumbent. If C2-Y beats UISB, we have beaten the strongest publicly plausible baseline. If C2-Y does not beat UISB, we have not even beaten the public-knowledge baseline.

experiment_design.pre_registration: This design is pre-registered BEFORE any C2-Y code runs. Per Article XIX, no parameter may be tuned after C2-Y results are known.

stratification.failure_mode: 60 patients per failure mode × 5 modes (obstruction, overdrainage, underdrainage, valve dysfunction, posture artifact)
stratification.patient_variability: Age (pediatric 2-18, adult 18-80), sex, BMI, CSF production rate (0.3-0.5 mL/min), shunt anatomy
stratification.sensor_noise_level: Low (0.5 mmHg std), Medium (1.5 mmHg std), High (3.0 mmHg std) — 100 patients each

patient_population.disease_progression_model: Gradual degradation: healthy (100% function) → 95% → 90% → ... → 50% → clinical failure. Each step takes 6-72 hours (randomized per patient).
patient_population.why_this_population: Stratification by failure mode ensures C2-Y is tested across the full failure-mode space, not just the easiest case. Stratification by sensor noise ensures robustness to realistic measurement conditions.

perturbations_applied_to_all_arms: Postural changes (supine → upright → supine) every 4-6 hours
CSF bolus (5 mL injected) at random times
Valsalva maneuver (cough, exercise) at random times
Sensor drift (1 mmHg/day linear drift, realistic for chronic sensor)
physiological_perturbations.why_these_perturbations: VIEshunt publicly demonstrates posture + CSF bolus response. Nature 2026 demonstrates chronic drift. We use both plus additional perturbations to ensure the test is harder than what either incumbent has publicly addressed.

measurement_availability.rule: All arms receive EXACTLY the same sensor data stream. No arm has privileged information.
measurement_availability.sensor_data_stream: Continuous ICP measurement at 1 Hz, posture (IMU) at 1 Hz, optional CSF drug concentration (for C3-X-style cross-reference, not used by C2-Y)

what_each_arm_does_with_the_data.UISB_baseline: Uses ICP + posture for adaptive control (UISB-A) + threshold alerting (UISB-C). No prediction, no classification.
what_each_arm_does_with_the_data.C2_Y_candidate: Uses ICP + posture + (optional) response-manifold features extracted from the same stream. The candidate may extract features that the baseline does not, but CANNOT receive additional sensor data.

computational_budget.rule: All arms have the same computational budget: max 1 FLOP/s avg over 1-hour windows (equivalent to a low-power embedded processor). This prevents C2-Y from winning by brute-force computation that the incumbent could not afford.
computational_budget.why_constrained: Real shunt implants are battery-powered. A predictor that requires a GPU is not clinically practical. The budget constraint forces C2-Y to be efficient, not just accurate.
computational_budget.monitoring: Computational cost is logged per arm per hour. Exceeding the budget is a CI failure.

false_alarm_constraint.rule: All arms operate at the SAME pre-registered false-alarm rate: <= 1 false alarm per patient-month
false_alarm_constraint.rationale: Lead time alone is gameable (over-sensitive alarm gives high lead time but unacceptable false alarms). Conditioning on fixed FPR forces the candidate to earn its lead time through specificity.
false_alarm_constraint.implementation: Each arm's alert threshold is tuned to achieve exactly 1 FA/patient-month on the training cohort. The threshold is then frozen for the test cohort. Per Article XIX, no post-hoc threshold adjustment.

primary_endpoint.mathematical_definition: Lead time (hours) = t_clinical_failure - t_first_alarm, where t_first_alarm is the first alarm that occurs within 72h before t_clinical_failure, conditioned on FPR = 1 FA/patient-month over the patient-month horizon.
primary_endpoint.why_this_endpoint: Per CEO directive: 'The real question is: does longitudinal latent-degradation prediction provide clinically meaningful warning BEFORE a VIEshunt-like intelligent control system would detect the same deterioration? That needs a temporal benchmark. I would make the decisive metric: lead time at a fixed false-alarm burden, not lead time alone.'

secondary_endpoints: false_alarms_per_patient_month at the lead-time operating point (for verification of FPR constraint)
robustness_index (lead-time degradation under sensor drift / model mismatch / patient transfer)
experiment_design.stratification_analysis: Per CEO directive: 'Then stratify by: obstruction, overdrainage, underdrainage, valve dysfunction, posture effects, patient variability.' Each failure mode is analyzed independently. C2-Y must achieve the WIN threshold on EACH failure mode, not just on aggregate. This prevents C2-Y from winning by excelling on the easiest failure mode while failing on the others.

pre_registered_outcomes_table.outcome: WIN | KILL | INCONCLUSIVE per failure mode × arm
rows: aggregate (all modes pooled) × UISB vs C2-Y
pre_registered_outcomes_table.decision_rule: C2-Y is WIN only if ALL 6 rows achieve WIN. C2-Y is KILL if ANY row achieves KILL. Otherwise C2-Y is INCONCLUSIVE.
pre_registered_outcomes_table.why_this_strict_rule: Article XIX — never optimize for the gate. If C2-Y excels on obstruction but fails on valve dysfunction, the system has not demonstrated a general failure-prediction capability — it has demonstrated obstruction detection, which is already largely solved by threshold alerting.

falsification_paths.path: C2-Y lead time <= 4h at FPR target on aggregate → KILL
falsification_paths.evidence_required: Median lead time across all 300 patients < 4h

falsification_paths.path: C2-Y does not achieve >70% classification accuracy on ANY failure mode → KILL on that mode → KILL on aggregate if >=2 modes killed
UISB baseline underperforms published VIEshunt response by >20% → BASELINE INCOMPLETE → experiment BLOCKED
falsification_paths.evidence_required: Comparison of UISB-A controller ICP error response to VIEshunt-published Figure 4-5
falsification_paths.constitutional_basis: Article XXIX — separate implementation from mechanism. A baseline reproduction failure is NOT a C2-Y failure.

falsification_paths.path: C2-Y achieves lead time >4h but <24h on aggregate → INCONCLUSIVE
falsification_paths.next_step: Tighten experiment design OR public KILL with rationale that the question was asked and not answered (Article XXVIII — no silent promotion)

adversarial_self_attack.attack_1_weak_baseline: An adversary would implement UISB-A controller with weak gains to make C2-Y look better. Counter: controller gains pre-registered from VIEshunt-published ICP error response (Figure 4-5 of PMID 40087797). Gains frozen BEFORE C2-Y runs. Any post-hoc tuning forbidden (Article XIX).
adversarial_self_attack.attack_2_easy_cohort: An adversary would test on a cohort with easy failure modes (e.g., all obstruction). Counter: cohort is stratified across 5 failure modes; C2-Y must win on EACH mode, not just aggregate.
adversarial_self_attack.attack_3_low_noise: An adversary would test under low-noise conditions. Counter: cohort includes 100 patients at HIGH sensor noise (3 mmHg std). C2-Y must achieve WIN threshold at HIGH noise, not just low noise.
adversarial_self_attack.attack_4_metric_gaming: An adversary would report lead time without FPR constraint. Counter: lead time is reported AT FPR=1/month, conditioned on FPR. Operating point chosen before lead time is measured.
adversarial_self_attack.attack_5_cherry_picking: An adversary would cherry-pick the best operating point. Counter: operating point pre-registered; only one operating point per arm tested on the test cohort.
adversarial_self_attack.attack_6_silent_promotion: An adversary would silently promote 'beat UISB' to 'beat VIEshunt'. Counter: explicit naming 'UISB-like baseline, NOT VIEshunt'. Article XXVIII forbids silent semantic promotion.

what_this_experiment_does_NOT_prove: Does NOT prove C2-Y beats the real VIEshunt — VIEshunt is a prototype, its chronic behavior is UNKNOWN
Does NOT prove C2-Y beats the real Nature ICP monitor — Nature monitor is a sensor, not a predictor
Does NOT prove C2-Y beats the real Codman threshold alerting — Codman is a threshold system, not a predictor
Does NOT prove C2-Y beats an incumbent with undisclosed internal R&D — Article XXXII alternative explanation stated explicitly
DOES prove: C2-Y beats the strongest publicly plausible combination of demonstrated capabilities, at matched FPR, on a stratified virtual cohort, under realistic noise/drift.
next_step_if_WIN: Proceed to independent reproduction (Article XXVIII): re-run on external solver (e.g., a different CFD/FSI simulator) to confirm the prediction is not over-fit to our internal World C. If independent reproduction fails, C2-Y is KILLED retroactively.
next_step_if_KILL: C2-Y is added to the cemetery with explicit rationale. The 7-successor discovery queue is updated. The next-ranked successor (C5-X) is selected.
next_step_if_INCONCLUSIVE: C2-Y remains in INVESTIGATION. A tightened experiment design is proposed (e.g., different cohort, different sensor model, different metric aggregation). Public KILL is preferred over indefinite INCONCLUSIVE per Article XXXIII (no irreversible action on unresolved evidence — but also no permanent limbo).
